layout.footer_tagline: Open-source software, cloud infrastructure and developer tools for modern teams.

hero.heading: Open-source software for modern teams
hero.text: OpenLogiks designs and builds custom software, cloud infrastructure and developer tools, so your team can ship reliable products faster.

hero.heading: About OpenLogiks
hero.text: We are a team of engineers who believe great software should be open, reliable and built to last.

story.heading: Our story
story.text1: OpenLogiks started with a simple idea: software companies should build on open foundations instead of locking clients into proprietary black boxes.
story.text2: Today we help organizations of all sizes design, build and run software and cloud infrastructure that they fully own and understand.

mission.heading: Our mission
mission.text: To make modern engineering practices and open-source technology accessible to every team we work with, from startups to enterprises.

open.title: Openness
open.text: We favor open standards and open-source tools, and we are transparent with clients at every step.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: We care about code that is tested, documented and built to be maintained for years, not weeks.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.text: We work as an extension of your team, not just an outside vendor.

hero.heading: Services
hero.text: From a first prototype to running infrastructure at scale, here is how we help.

custom.title: Custom Software Development
custom.text: Web and backend applications designed around your workflows, built with modern, maintainable stacks and clean APIs.

cloud.title: Cloud & DevOps
cloud.text: Cloud architecture, containers, CI/CD pipelines and observability, so releases are routine instead of risky.

open.title: Open-Source Engineering
open.text: We build on proven open-source foundations and, where it helps, open-source the tools we create along the way.

support.title: Support & Maintenance
support.text: Ongoing monitoring, upgrades and a direct line to the engineers who know your system best.

custom.title: Custom Software
custom.text: Bespoke applications and platforms built around how your business actually works.

cloud.title: Cloud & DevOps
cloud.text: Infrastructure, CI/CD and automation so your teams ship faster and sleep better.

open.title: Open Source
open.text: We build on and contribute back to open-source tools, no vendor lock-in.

support.title: Ongoing Support
support.text: Long-term maintenance and support plans that keep systems healthy.
